description: Which lines a comment directive suppresses (getDiagnosticsWithPrecedingDirectives and isCommentOrBlankLine): `// @ts-ignore` or `// @ts-expect-error`, then one intervening line, blank or a line comment, after an empty, space, tab, no-break space, vertical tab, form feed, or byte order mark prefix, with every line ended by LF, CR, CRLF, U+2028, or U+2029, before a missing module (TS2307) or before each of two conflicting declarations (TS2451). Only a space or tab prefix and only CR, LF, or the end of the text end a blank line.
